reconstruction.scope: Individual Akhtamar Holy Cross medium-fi exterior: warm ashlar cross-gabled church with faceted drum, ribbed stone cone/cross, polygonal corner niches and narrow arched lights; low western narthex and northeast annex; southern two-stage bell entrance with open upper arches and six-column stone pavilion/cone. Shared stone/wood/metal surfaces, selective relief-band/medallion abstractions and four browser LODs. All heights/internal plans approximate. Narrative relief sculptures,inscriptions,frescoes,complete interior and island monastery/paths excluded or simplified.
